hooks.command: CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$CMD" in *"git push"*) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && python3 .claude/scripts/verify_keymap.py >&2 || exit 2;; esac
AHEAD=$(git rev-list --count @{u}..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0); [ "$AHEAD" -gt 0 ] && echo "Reminder: $AHEAD unpushed commit(s). Run /build to push and trigger CI." || true
